script_text: Mars rages through your fire sign, Aries, as the cosmos screams loudly at you now. Saturn in Taurus is now opposing your Sun, pulling intense pressure onto your 1st House of self and your 7th House of partnerships. This heavyweight square creates a slow‑burn tension that forces you to rebuild boundaries and mature your connections. In love, the Saturn opposition warns you not to rush commitments, seeking partners who respect your fire, and set a bold tone for new connections. Career-wise, Mercury enters your 10th House, forming a sextile to Jupiter that boosts promotions if you act decisively. Financially, the 2nd House feels stable today, so big purchases are favorable. Beware of over‑cautious paralysis—let Mercury‑Jupiter’s trine fuel action, not stall, and seize the moment boldly. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you stay ahead of the cosmic currents and tomorrow's news.
